childNodes.textContent: Blocks proof of concept — Enterprise AI

Blocks proof of concept — a business process becomes four steps, one
  smart block on each, set up a little, then run. For you, or for a
  client in their brand.

  Skinned as the marketing site in the new brand (sell-to-many remix 24:
  ?theme=brand&layout=mvp2, brand book v5). The page, the builder frame and the client's
  app all use that site's own stylesheets and brand lookup, linked from
  sell-to-many/ rather than copied, so it looks like the same product.

  Three ways in: ?t=edm, ?t=screening, ?combo=1. See README.md here.
  With a model: python3 live.py --blocks

childNodes.textContent: Describe something you deliver for clients, or start from a template. It becomes four steps with one smart block on each, set up in your brand or your client’s.
Describe how the work gets done today, or attach the procedure
We write it down, Jev checks whether one of the 20 templates already does the job, and if not, we turn it into four steps of your own.
Every one is four steps, one block each.
One brief in, a branded campaign email out, signed off before it goes.
Describe the role, add the CVs, get a scored table, agree a shortlist.
Upload the invoice, key in the details, check it against the PO, get it approved.
Claim it, add the receipts, check it against policy, manager approves.
Ask for it, add quotes, compare them, budget owner approves.
Capture the supplier, collect their documents, check them, approve.
Set the requirements, collect responses, score them, panel decides.
Capture the business, collect ID, write the KYC summary, approve the account.
Apply, add the financials, write the credit memo, credit decides.
Request it, attach anything needed, summarise it, manager approves.
Capture the new starter, collect their paperwork, write the welcome, HR signs off.
Describe the role, add the evidence, write the business case, approve the hire.
Take the complaint, add evidence, draft the reply, team lead approves it.
Bring the tickets in, triage each, write the handover, lead picks priorities.
Report the incident, add evidence, write the assessment, claims decides.
Request a review, upload the contract, flag risky clauses, legal signs off.
Report it, add photos, write the investigation, WHS signs off.
Request the permit, attach the method statement, check the risks, supervisor then HSE approve.
Brief it, add references, get a first draft, the editor approves.
Apply, add supporting documents, score each application, panel decides.
Step 1, then 2, then 3, then 4. No branches.
Each block has a short list of settings. Compose has a prompt you can add to.
Build it once, then set it up again for the next client.
